name: 林懷恩
objective:
積體電路為現今社會最重要之高科技產業，本課程將提供學生半導體材料、物理性質、製程原理及元件架構等之基本概念，課程內容共分為三個部分：(1) 半導體材料與物理、(2) 半導體元件及基本概念、(3) 積體電路重要製程與設備。
Integrated circuits are among the most important high-technology industries in modern society. This course provides students with fundamental concepts related to semiconductor materials, physical properties, fabrication principles, and device structures. The course content is divided into 3 main sections:
(1) Semiconductor Materials & Physics,
(2) Semiconductor Devices and Fundamental Concepts,
(3) Key Integrated Circuit Fabrication Processes and Equipment.
schedule:
第 1 週
09/10 課程內容簡介 Course Overview
第 2 週
09/17 晶體結構與矽半導體物理特性、半導體能帶與載子傳輸
Crystal structures & physical properties of silicon semiconductors, semiconductor energy bands & carrier transport
第 3 週
09/24 化合物半導體晶體結構與物理特性、半導體基礎元件
Crystal structures & physical properties of compound semiconductors, fundamental semiconductor devices
第 4 週
10/01 半導體基礎元件、接面能帶圖與費米能階、積體電路製程與佈局
Fundamental semiconductor devices, basic semiconductor devices, junction energy band diagrams, & Fermi energy levels, IC fabrication processes & layout design
第 5 週
10/08 半導體元件縮小化與先進奈米元件、高速與高功率元件
Semiconductor device scaling & advanced nanoscale devices, high-speed & high-power semiconductor devices
第 6 週
10/15 半導體光電元件 Semiconductor optoelectronic devices
第 7 週
10/22 矽晶棒生長、矽晶圓製作
Si crystal growth & wafer fabrication
第 8 週
10/29 矽磊晶生長、矽磊晶系統
Si epitaxial growth & epitaxial systems
第 9 週
11/05 期中考 Middle examination
第 10 週
11/12 化合物半導體晶棒生長、化合物半導體磊晶生長
Compound semiconductor crystal growth & epitaxial growth
第 11 週
11/19 矽氧化膜生長、矽氧化膜生長機制
Growth mechanisms of silicon oxide films
第 12 週
11/26 擴散理論、離子佈植
Diffusion theory & ion implantation
第 13 週
12/03 微影技術
Photolithography technology
第 14 週
12/10 蝕刻技術
Etching technology
第 15 週
12/17 氣相沉積技術
Vapor deposition technology
第 16 週
12/24 實務案例討論 (1)
Case study (1)
第 17 週
12/31 實務案例討論 (2)
Case study (2)
第 18 週
01/07 期末考 Final examination
